Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players can be seen in a huddle receiving some pep talk from their skipper, Suliman Safi. Chamindu Wickramasinghe and Sadisha Rajapaksa are the openers for Sri Lanka Under-19. Bilal Sami to start with the ball. There is some issue with the sightscreen. That's why the delay. All sorted now. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then! 135 is what Sri Lanka Under-19 need to chase it down and meet England Under-19 in the semis. The bowlers have done their job and it is upto their batters to do their counterpart now. Afghanistan Under-19 will need some magic to put up a show here and defend this total down. Join us back for the chase which will begin shortly.

Noor Ahmad is in for a spot interview. He says, they will try to put up a good fight. Mentions, he just tried to put some pressure back on the opposition. Adds, they have a good spinning side and would try to keep it very disciplined in the middle.

Sri Lanka Under-19 bowlers were simply outstanding. The bowlers started well at the start and after the rain break, they were just impeccable. Traveen Mathews first got the breakthrough and then, Vinuja Ranpul, who is playing the first match of the tournament kept bowling on tight lines and lengths and removed three Afghanistan batters in his eight-over opening spell. The bowlers never let the pressure come off and there was a partnership building but Dunith Wellalage came to the rescue putting Afghanistan Under-19 in all sorts of trouble. He picked up three wickets in total but the star for them was clearly Vinuja Ranpul who finished with a five-fer to his name. His figures read (9.1-3-10-5). Simply outstanding!

Afghanistan Under-19 wouldn't have wanted this, especially in a quarterfinal. Their opening pair, Bilal Sayeedi and Nangeyalia Kharote found it tough to keep the scoreboard ticking and counter spin. Once Sayeedi fell, the side lost wickets in a heap as they went from 24/0 to 26/4. They badly needed a partnership and Allah Noor and Abdul Hadi did stitch one but the former got out. Hadi started to up the ante towards the end but it was Noor Ahmad who kept swinging everything that came on his way and did very well for his 30. But both the batters got out off consecutive deliveries and Afghanistan Under-19 could not breach the 150-run mark.

Excellent bowling from Sri Lanka Under-19. The bowlers ran riot early on with Vinuja Ranpul bagging three in quick succession and he is the one who finishes things off. Well deserved five-fer and he walks off with an applause. Afghanistan Under-19 were put under enormous pressure from which they could not recover. The wickets kept falling for them and as a result, they have only managed to put on a mediocre total on the board. Sri Lanka Under-19 will fancy their chances here. It would require some really hard work from the bowlers of Afghanistan Under-19 as the pitch is only getting better for batting.

OUT! TIMBER! What a day it has been for Vinuja Ranpul. He picks up a five-fer in his first game of the campaign. Vinuja Ranpul fires in a yorker, on the off stump. Izharulhaq Naveed looks to heave it away but misses and the ball hits the base of the off stump. Afghanistan Under-19 have been bundled out for 134.
Floated, full and outside off. Zadran looks to chase it but misses.
Naveed Zadran is the last basman to come out to bat.

OUT! LBW! Dunith Wellalage is in a hurry to end the innings here. Afghanistan Under-19 are nine down now. This is short, angled in on middle and leg. Sami looks to defend it out but misses and gets rapped on the pads. Dunith Wellalage puts in an appeal. The umpire thinks about it for a while and raises his dreaded finger. Bilal Sami was not happy about it at all, he was standing his ground before walking back to the pavilion.
Around off, pushed to cover for a single.
Outside off, Naveed looks to chase it but misses.
Full, on leg, Sami flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Bilal Sami walks out to bat.

OUT! STUMPED! Sri Lanka Under-19 back on track here. This time a set batsman making his way out. The skipper, Dunith Wellalage, picks up his second wicket in his final over. Tossed up, wide outside off. Hadi charges forward but misses it completely. Anjala Bandara gathers the ball and was quick to clip the bails off. He has been sharp throughout the game and now gets rewarded with a stumping.
Commentary.Howout: st Anjala Bandara b Dunith Wellalage

Commentary.Commentary: The new batter in is Izharulhaq Naveed.

OUT! CAUGHT! Vinuja Ranpul comes back into the attack and strikes on his last delivery of the over. He send back Noor Ahmad who was on the charge here. Length ball, outside off. Ahmad swings hard at it. The ball flies towards third man off the splice. Sakuna Liyanage there dives forward to take a solid catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Sakuna Liyanage b Vinuja Ranpul

Commentary.Commentary: Length, slower one, wide outside off. Ahmad shuffles across and looks to heave it away but misses.
Full length, wide outside off. Ahmad looks to hit it down the ground but does not connect this time.
Slower bouncer, on middle. Noor Ahmad looks to pull but misses as he gets deceived by the lack of pace.
Length ball, outside off, stays a touch low. Noor Ahmad tries to swing across but gets beaten.
Slower ball, full and on leg. Hadi clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Short and on middle and leg. Noor Ahmad tries to pull but misses.
SIX! Didn't hit it from the middle of the bat but still goes the distance. This is poor bowling. Loopy ball, outside off. Noor Ahmad throws his bat at it and it goes over long off for a maximum.
Tossed up, outside off. Noor Ahmad again swings but this time doesn't connect.
SIX! Goes all the way! Sri Lanka Under-19 getting their length wrong here. This is full, on off. Noor Ahmad muscles ir over long on for a biggie.
Short and outside off. Noor Ahmad has a wild swing at it but misses.
Full and outside off. Hadi works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! It's raining sixes suddenly. Length ball, outside off. Noor Ahmad clears his front leg and hammers this one over long on for a maximum. 19 runs off the over.

SIX! Another biggie! Afghanistan Under-19 are trying to get as much runs as they can in these final overs. Full, outside off. Noor Ahmad slices it over deep cover for a biggie. Useful runs for Afghanistan Under-19.
Fuller in length, outside off. Noor Ahmad swings across the line but misses to connect yet again.
Length ball, outside off. Noor Ahmad swings but misses.
On a length, outside off. Abdul Hadi dabs it to third man for one.
SIX! Good hit! Up and over! Length ball, on middle. Abdul Hadi stands tall and lofts it over long on. The fielder there leaps but the ball goes over his head for a maximum.
Full and on off, Abdul Hadi dances down the track and gets an inside edge to square leg for a single.
Flatter ball, on leg. Abdul Hadi looks to sweep it on the leg side but gets hit on the thigh pad. Dunith Wellalage appeals for an lbw but that was going down leg.
On off, Abdul Hadi blocks it watchfully.
On middle, worked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker ball, on middle and leg. Noor Ahmad looks to heave it away but misses.
Flatter ball, sliding down the leg side. Noor Ahmad looks to flick but misses. The ball hits his pads and goes to fine leg for two leg byes.
Short of a length, outside off. Pushed to backward point.
Short of a length again, outside off. Abdul Hadi looks to push it but fails to connect.
Short of a length, outside off. Abdul Hadi slashes but misses.
Short of a length, outside off. Abdul Hadi defends it to the off side.
On a length, on middle. Abdul Hadi defends it out.
Fuller in length, outside off. Noor Ahmad works it to deep mid-wicket. He calls for two but the batters only settle for a single.
Flatter ball, on middle. Hadi blocks it towards covers. 5 rund from the over.
Full and on middle, pushed towards covers.
FOUR! Afghanistan Under-19 need more of these! Full and outside off. Abdul Hadi lifts it over covers for a boundary.
On middle, Hadi blocks it solidly.
Loopy ball, on middle. Hadi blocks it out.
Short and on off, punched to sweeper cover for a single.
End of Powerplay 2! Now 5 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle until the end of the innings. Shevon Daniel to continue with the ball for Sri Lanka Under-19.
Good length, angled in on off. Hadi pushes it to the left of the bowler. Rodrigo dives to that side to stop the ball. Just three runs off the over.
Low full toss, on off. Ahmad lofts it towards mid on and gets a single.
Length, on off, blocked back to the bowler.
A full-length ball, just outside off. Hadi miscues his shot and lofts it towards cover. They take a single.
Full length, outside off. Ahmad lifts it towards mid off for a single.
Full length, outside off. Ahmad looks to chase it but misses.
Tossed up, on off. Hadi pushes it to cover. The fielder there dives to his right to make a sharp stop. This is brilliant fielding by the Sri Lanka Under-19 players.
Fuller, outside off. Hadi drives it towards mid off. The fielder dives to his left to make a good stop.
Around off, blocked out solidly.
An arm ball, around off. this one comes in. Hadi gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Full and on off. Hadi blocks it back to the bowler.
Angled in, full and on middle. Hadi defends it out watchfully.
Yasiru Rodrigo hits the hard length, outside off. Ahmad looks to cut it away but misses. A maiden for Rodrigo.
A slower, short ball, outside off. Ahmad looks to pull it away but misses.
Full length, wide outside off, shaping away. Ahmad looks to go for the expansive drive now but is beaten.
Make that three! This is on a good length, outside off. This one does not bounce as much as Ahmad thought it would. He looks to heave it away across the line but the ball sneaks underneath the blade.
Two dots in a row! Touch short, on off, close to the body. Ahmad steers it to short third man.
Good length ball, outside off. Ahmad plays it late and guides it towards backward point.
Full, on middle, Ahmad eases it down to long on for a single.
Floated, full, on middle and leg. Ahmad works it to mid-wicket off the inner half.
Tossed up, outside off, Hadi pushes it through mid off for a single.
Full and on off. Hadi blocks it back to the bowler.
Full and on the pads. Hadi nudges it on the leg side.
Loopy ball, outside off, turning away. Abdul Hadi looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Beaten! Good-length ball, outside off, angling across. Noor Ahmad looks to heave it away but misses.
A bit of a yes-no, but no harm done! Short of a length, outside off. Noor Ahmad defends it out.
Noor Ahmad comes in at number 8.

OUT! CAUGHT! Mohammad Ishaq was looking good in his short stay but has to depart. Afghanistan Under-19 in all kinds of trouble. Yasiru Rodrigo comes back into the attack and gets a wicket. Short of a length, outside off. Mohammad Ishaq went for the cut but hit it into the hands of Shevon Daniel at point who catches this above his head. Another one bites the dust for Afghanistan Under-19.
Commentary.Howout: c Shevon Daniel b Yasiru Rodrigo

Commentary.Commentary: Short of a length, outside off. Mohammad Ishaq defends it out.

That stays low! Length ball, outside off, the ball dies on the way through. Mohammad Ishaq looks to cut but misses. The keeper fumbles to collect the ball and Abdul Hadi looks to steal a single but is sent back. There is a shy at the bowler's end but didn't hit the stumps.
On a length, around off. Abdul Hadi taps it to cover for a quick single.

DRINKS! Afghanistan Under-19 have managed to score some runs but still they only have five wickets in hand. They will hope to bat till the final over the innings and try to up the ante in the final 10 to get across 160. Sri Lanka Under-19, on the other hand, have lost their grip a bit over the opposition. But still a wicket can change the trajectory of the game. An interesting passage of play awaits.
Full and on off, worked to long on for a single.
On middle, blocked out.
Sri Lanka Under-19 players are sharp in the field! Loopy ball, on middle. Abdul Hadi sweeps it to square leg where the fielder dives to his right to stop the ball.
Quicker delivery, outside off. Abdul Hadi looks to push at it but misses.
Full and on middle, pushed to mid on.
Flatter ball, outside off. Abdul Hadi defends it to the off side.
Full and outside off, Mohammad Ishaq reaches out for it and drives it towards covers.
SIX! Smashed! First maximum of the innings! Tossed up, outside off. Mohammad Ishaq gets down on one knee and slog-sweeps it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
On middle, Mohammad Ishaq stays back and defends.
Full and on off, defended out.
Lovely! Loopy ball, outside off, spinning away. Mohammad Ishaq looks to drive but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Flighted ball, full and on off. Mohammad Ishaq looks to drive. The ball goes off the inner half back to the bowler.
Full and outside off. Abdul Hadi defends it back to the bowler.
Full and on leg. Mohammad Ishaq sweeps it to deep square leg. The fielder, Traveen Mathews, does well in the deep to save the boundary. The batters take three.
Mohammad Ishaq is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Wonderful bowling by Dunith Wellalage and he gets into the wickets column as well. Turn and bounce there for him. Tossed up delivery, outside off, turning away. Allah Noor looks to push it to the off side. The ball catches the outside edge and goes straight into the hands of Ranuda Somarathne at first slip. Afghanistan Under-19 lose their fifth wicket now. The 47-run has been broken and Sri Lanka Under-19 will look to fold the innings soon now.
Commentary.Howout: c Ranuda Somarathne b Dunith Wellalage

Commentary.Commentary: Is that out? The umpire takes it upstairs. The replays roll in to confirm Noor had his back foot behind the line. The final decision is not out.

NOT OUT! Tossed up, outside off. Allah Noor presses forward and looks to defend but misses. The keeper whips the bails off and appeals for stumping and the umpire takes it upstairs. Replay shows that Allah Noor was inside the crease.
Full and on middle. Noor blocks it out. Sri Lanka Under-19 are not allowing runs to come easy here.
Loopy ball, on off. Allah Noor defends it off the front foot.
Well bowled! A single from the over! Tossed up, on middle. Hadi defends it out.
Full and on middle. Allah Noor looks to defend. The ball goes off the inside edge to mid-wicket for a run.
Flighted ball, outside off. Allah Noor drives it towards extra cover. The fielder dives to his right to stop the ball.
On middle, defended out off the front foot.
Flatter ball, on middle. Allah Noor defends it to the off side.
Full and on off, blocked back to the bowler.
On off, pushed to covers. Traveen Mathews ends his spell with a maiden.
Full toss and on off. Abdul Hadi hits it to cover but straight to the man.
Full and outside off. Hadi looks to defend but gets an outside edge past the keeper.
Short and outside off. Hadi cuts it hard to covers. The fielder does well to gather it.
On off, blocked out.
Tossed up, outside off. Hadi gets an outside edge towards point but it lands safely.
Full, on leg, Hadi flicks it to long on for a single.
Full and outside off, turning in a hint. Hadi leans in and blocks it into the deck.
Tossed up, full and on middle. Hadi presses forward and blocks it back to the bowler.
Around off, turning in. Hadi stays back and pushes it to the off side.
On off, driven towards cover for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played. The partnership is growing in confidence now. Full and outside off. Noor slaps it past extra cover for a boundary.
Raveen de Silva comes into the attack now.
Floated, full and outside off. Noor strides in and gets an inside edge onto the pads. The keeper appeals as the ball sneaks past him. They take a single.
On off, blocked out watchfully.
Back of a length, outside off. Noor cuts it through point. The fielders work in tandem to save a certain boundary. They take two.
Short and outside off. Hadi punches it through covers for a single.
Full, on middle and leg. Hadi clips it to mid-wicket.
Full and on middle. Noor gets it to mid on off the inner half for a single.
Full and on off. Noor drives it down the ground to long off for a single.
Slower through the air, outside off. Noor pushes it to cover but straight to the man.
Around off, pushed to covers.
Tossed up, wide outside off. Noor reaches out and cuts it aerially towards backward point. It meets the fielder on a bounce.
Looped up, on off. Hadi flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted, full and outside off. Hadi pushes it to cover. Not in the gap.
On off, blocked back to the bowler.
Full, on middle and leg, Noor flicks it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up, outside off. Noor drives it to cover.
Looped up, full and outside off. Noor strides in and blocks it into the deck.
Fuller, and outside off. Hadi pushes it to cover. They take a run.
Floated, full and outside off. Noor drives it to long off for a run.
Looped up, around off. Hadi stays back and defends it out.
Full and outside off, pushed towards mid off.
Short and on the pads. Hadi leaves it alone. The ball goes to fine leg off the thigh pads.
WIDE! Full, sliding down leg. Hadi looks to sweep it but misses. Wide called.
Tossed up, full and outside off. Hadi looks to punch it to the off side but misses.
Flatter and outside off. Hadi pushes it to point.
Full and outside off. Noor pushes it to long off for a single.
Full and on middle. Defended off the front foot. At the halfway mark, Afghanistan Under-19 are 55/4.
Short and outside off, Abdul Hadi leaves it alone.
That one kept a little low! Floats it up, on middle. Allah Noor tries to tuck on the leg side. The ball goes off the outside edge to point for a single.
Full and outside off. Allah Noor comes forward and defends it back to the bowler.
WIDE! Turning down the leg side. Noor leaves it alone. Wided.
Tossed up, on middle. Blocked out.
Good turn and bounce! Loopy ball, on middle. Nudged to mid-wicket.
Back of a length, on off. Allah Noor tucks it on the leg side for a single.
Length ball, on middle. Abdul Hadi looks to defend. The ball goes off the inside edge on the leg side and the batters take a single.
Full again, on off. Hadi pushes it to mid off.
Fuller in length, on middle. Driven back to the bowler.
WIDE! Length ball, way too outside off. Left alone. Wided.
Length ball, on middle. Defended out.
Length ball, on middle. Allah Noor shuffles and plays it to square leg for a single. 50 up for Afghanistan Under-19.
Some turn there! Loopy ball, outside off, Abdul Hadi looks to push. The ball goes off the inside edge and beats the keeper to fine leg for a couple of runs.
Outside off, Abdul Hadi looks to dab but gets an under-edge and the ball drops dead on the pitch.
Floats it up, on middle. Abdul Hadi gets a good stride forward and looks to defend but misses. He gets hit on the thigh pad. An appeal for an lbw but not given.
On the pads, swept to short fine leg.
Flatter ball, outside off. Pushed towards covers.
Short and outside off. Nudged to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, left alone again. So, just the single off the over.
Fuller, outside off. Abdul Hadi steers it to backward point.
Good-length ball, on middle. Abdul Hadi defends it to the off side.
Fuller, on middle. Pushed back to the bowler.
On a good length, in the fifth stump channel. Left alone by Hadi.
Short of a length, on off. Allah Noor hops and taps it to point for one.
FOUR! In the gap! That will give him some confidence. Full and outside off, Abdul Hadi keeps his eyes nicely on the ball and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Short and outside off, Allah Noor plays it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Floats it up, on middle. Abdul Hadi stays back and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on off, driven to long off for a run.
Beauty! Tossed up, outside off. Allah Noor presses forward to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Loopy ball, outside off. Pushed back to the bowler.
FOUR! A rare boundary for Afghanistan Under-19. A much-needed one. Full length, outside off. Hadi reaches out and drives it through point for a boundary.
BEATEN! Good length, angled across the left-hander, some extra bounce this time. Abdul Hadi looks to chase it but misses.
Fuller, down leg. Noor stays back and flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single. Traveen Mathews does well to not allow the batters to take the second run.
Full and outside off, Noor defends it to the off side.
A yorker now, on middle and off. Noor digs it back to the bowler.
Full length, on off. Noor drives it towards mid off. Dunith Wellalage runs to his right and makes a good stop.
An appeal for lbw but turned down! Full and on leg, angled in. Hadi looks to defend it out but gets hit on the pads. Going down leg.
Full and on off, blocked out watchfully.
Flighted, outside off. Hadi remains solid in his defense.
Full and outside off. Hadi blocks it out watchfully.
Quicker, tossed up, outside off, this one turns in sharply. Hadi gets beaten and is hit on the pads. Dunith Wellalage appeals but the umpire is unmoved.
Flatter and on off. Noor flicks it to the leg side for a quick single.
Here comes the Sri Lanka Under-19 skipper, Dunith Wellalage who is the highest wicket-taker of the tournament at the moment.
Good length, close to the off stump. Hadi taps it to point. A good start for Chamindu Wickramasinghe, just a single off it.
A single now! These are precious runs for Afghanistan Under-19. Back of a length, outside off. Noor cuts it to sweeper cover for a rare single.
Good length, in the corridor of uncertainty. Noor shuffles across and blocks it to cover.
Fuller, on middle. Noor blocks it to mid on with the full face of the blade.
Length ball, outside off, this one stays very low off the deck. Noor does chase this on but it sneaks under his blade.
A low full toss, outside off. Noor slashes it towards backward point. The fielder does well to make the stop.
Chamindu Wickramasinghe is brought into the attack now. He replaces Vinuja Ranpul.
Around middle, worked towards long on for a single.
Outside off, Noor looks to defend it out but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Around off, Noor defends it out solidly.
Full and outside off, Noor looks to have a poke at it but misses. This is some briliant bowling by Traveen Mathews.

BYE! The ball is a spitting cobra here. Tossed up, full and outside off. Hadi leans out to defend it out. The ball turns away and bounces off the deck sharply and Hadi is beaten. It goes past the keeper and the batters collect a bye.
CLOSE! Floated, full and outside off. Hadi leans forward and drives it aerially past the silly point. Abdul Hadi would've had his heart in his mouth for a second.

Drinks! Sri Lanka Under-19 bowlers have been nothing less than exceptional. They have kept the pressure on with probing lines and lengths and as a result, have got 4 wickets as well. Afghanistan Under-19 now badly need a partnership and they would hope the current pair of Abdul Hadi and Allah Noor to take them to safer shores.
A single off the last ball restricts Vinuja Ranpul to get his fourth maiden. Back of a length, on the short. Hadi flicks it through square leg for a run.
Five dots on the trot! A length ball, around off, nips in a touch. Hadi stays inside the crease and defends it to cover.
A short ball, on off, Hadi jumps and defends it out to the off side.
Three dots in a row for Vinuja Ranpul. A full-length ball, close to off stump. Hadi blocks it to cover. Vinuja Ranpul dominating with the ball here.
Full length, on the stumps now. Hadi gets his blade down and defends it out solidly.
A full-length ball, outisde off, shaping across the left-hander. Hadi leaves it alone.
Flighted ball, outside off. Allah Noor drives it to mid off. Just 2 runs and 2 wickets off the last twelve deliveries. Sri Lanka Under-19 well on top here.
Loopy ball, on off. Allah Noor pressed forward to defend.
Outside off, Allah Noor defends it out off the front foot.
Floats it up, on off. Pushed towards covers.
In the air, but safe! Loopy ball, on off. Abdul Hadi looks to drive. The ball goes off the outside edge to point for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Abdul Hadi looks to drive but gets beaten on the outside edge.

Ohhh! That came back in late and Abdul Hadi does well to dig it out. Fuller in length, on middle. Digged out to square leg for a single. Excellent bowling from Vinuja Ranpul. Two wickets and 1 run off it.
Outside off, Abdul Hadi leaves it untouched.
Abdul Hadi is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Vinuja Ranpul is on a roll here. He bags his third wicket. Flurry of wickets for Afghanistan Under-19. They were 24/0 and have lost 4 wickets for just 2 runs. Top quality bowling from Sri Lanka Under-19 after a small rain break. Good-length ball, outside off, shaping away. Ijaz Ahmadzai goes for the drive but the ball kisses the outside edge and Anjala Bandara pouches it with both hands easily.
Commentary.Howout: c Anjala Bandara b Vinuja Ranpul

Commentary.Commentary: Width on offer, outside off. Ijaz Ahmadzai slashes it but straight to point.
Back of a length, on off. Ijaz Ahmadzai hops and blocks it out.
Ijaz Ahmadzai walks out at number 5.

OUT! LBW! That was dead plumb and the umpire raises his dreaded finger. The Afghanistan Under-19 skipper, Suliman Safi departs for just one. Good-length delivery, on middle, nipping back in a bit. Suliman Safi is late in his defense and gets hit on the pads. Vinuja Ranpul knew it straightaway that it was plumb and the umpire too agreed with it. Afghanistan Under-19 look to be in some trouble now.
Short and on off, Safi pushes it to cover.
Loopy ball, on off. Suliman Safi defends it to the off side.
On off, blocked out.
Short and on off, turning in. Noor hangs back and works it through mid on for a single.
Full and outside off. Noor leans forward and blocks it out.
Tossed up, on middle. Allah Noor blocks it out solidly.
On a good length, on off. Suliman Safi defends it out. Another wicket-maiden over.
Well bowled! Short ball, on leg. Suliman Safi looks to pull but gets pinged near the chest area.
On a good length, on off. Suliman Safi pokes it towards point.
Good-length ball, outside off. Suliman Safi is very watchful in his leave.
Very full, outside off. Driven towards covers.
Suliman Safi, the skipper comes out now. Can he take his side to safer shores?

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Vinuja Ranpul went past the outside edge too many times but this time finds the edge. Both the openers have been sent back to the pavilion now. Excellent bowling by Sri Lanka Under-19. They kept the pressure on with their probing lines and lengths and are now getting their rewards. Vinuja Ranpul hurls in a good-length ball, outside off, nipping away. Nangeyalia Kharote has a poke at it but the ball kisses the outside edge and Anjala Bandara does the rest behind the stumps. Now, Sri Lanka Under-19 have a tight grip over the opposition.
Commentary.Howout: c Anjala Bandara b Vinuja Ranpul

Commentary.Commentary: Allah Noor is the new man in.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! He has deceived him through mastery of trickery and sorcery. Traveen Mathews gets the breakthrough and he is delighted. Bilal Sayeedi's tough stay at the crease finally comes to an end. He was finding it difficult to rotate the strike and was clearly struggling. This one was tossed up, on off, spinning in. Bilal Sayeedi presses forward to defend but this time, the ball sneaks through the gate and disturbs the stumps behind. Afghanistan Under-19 lose their first wicket. Three maidens in a row for Traveen Mathews. A wicket-maiden this one!
Tossed up, on off. Bilal Sayeedi presses forward to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Floats it up, on middle and leg. Bilal Sayeedi blocks it out.
Stumping chance missed! Tossed up, on middle and leg, spinning in. Bilal Sayeedi dances out but misses the ball. The keeper fails to collect it as the ball bounced too much there.
Tossed up, on off. Bilal Sayeedi presses forward and defends it towards covers.
Flighted ball, on off. Driven towards covers.
Finally a run for Afghanistan Under-19 in 27 balls. This was short and outside off. Bilal Sayeedi stays back and chops it towards third man for a single.
Full length, on off. Bilal Sayeedi pushes it to cover but yet for just another dot.
Good length, on off. Bilal Sayeedi defends it out solidly.
A short ball, on middle. Bilal Sayeedi ducks under it. The keeper does well to stop it as it dies in front of him.

MIX UP! The pressure is getting to Afghanistan Under-19. Length ball, on off. Bilal Sayeedi pushes it to cover. He ventures out looking for a single but was sent back. The fielder has a shy at the striker's end but misses his attempt. If it was a direct-hit it could have been a different scenario.
Full length, outside off, moving away. Bilal Sayeedi leaves it alone for the keeper.
Short and on off. Nangeyalia Kharote punches it to cover, but not in the gap. Three maidens in a row now.
On off, blocked out watchfully.
BEATEN! Tossed up, full and outside off, it turns away off the deck. Nangeyalia Kharote presses forward and looks to defend it out, only to get beaten on the outside edge.
Floated, full and on off. Nangeyalia Kharote gets it to the leg side off the inside edge.
Short and on off. Nangeyalia Kharote pushes it to the off side.
Full and outside off. Nangeyalia Kharote defends it out watchfully.
Yes he will! This was short and outside off. This time Bilal Sayeedi stands back and cuts it straight to the man at point. He does not middle it and a good over by Vinuja Ranpul.
Good length ball, on the fifth stump line. Bilal Sayeedi does not want to chase away from his body. Five dots in a row, can Vinuja Ranpul gets his second maiden of the innings?

The bowler is not happy with the landing area. The groundmen get some sawdust and apply it near the popping crease as well as near the run-up mark. A little bit of delay in play but all sorted now and we are set to resume. Well we can certainly see the unity amongst the Sri Lanka Under-19 players. Their skipper, Dunith Wellalage, uses the time and calls his team-mates in a huddle to pass on some motivating words.
Good length ball, on top of off. Bilal Sayeedi gets behind the line and blocks it out solidly. Four dots in a row now.
Good-length ball, outside off, nips away after hitting the deck. Bilal Sayeedi is not interested in playing this one as well.
Back of a length, outside off, shaping away a hint. Bilal Sayeedi shoulders his arms at it. He is being watchful after the restart.
Good length, outside off. Bilal Sayeedi leaves it alone for the keeper.
We are ready to resume! The players stride out to the middle. Nangeyalia Kharote and Bilal Sayeedi to resume their innings. Vinuja Ranpul to bowl.

UPDATE - 7.10 pm IST (1.40 pm GMT) - The covers are off now. As expected, it was just a passing shower. The play will resume at 7.20 pm IST (1.50 pm GMT). The groundstaff are working on the ground to get ready and more importantly, we have not lost any overs.

UPDATE - 7.03 pm IST (1.33 pm GMT) - Oh oh! Not the news anyone would have wanted. Blue skies all around but it has started to drizzle. The covers are on at the moment. Let's hope the play resumes soon. Stay tuned.
Tossed up, around off. Nangeyalia Kharote blocks it out watchfully. A maiden to start with for Traveen Mathews.
On off, defened out.
Floated, full and outside off, turning away a bit. Nangeyalia Kharote looks to push it away but misses.
Full and outside off, Nangeyalia Kharote pushes it to cover.
Tossed up, full and outside off. Nangeyalia Kharote presses forward and defends it towards fine leg off the inside edge.
Some extra bounce, outside off. Nangeyalia Kharote leaves it alone.
Time for some spin! Traveen Mathews is brought into the attack. He replaces Yasiru Rodrigo.
Length ball, on off, Bilal Sayeedi blocks it out solidly.
Good length, on off, Bilal Sayeedi stays back and defends it out.
Outside off, Bilal Sayeedi looks to chase it but misses.
Full, outside off, Nangeyalia Kharote leans in and drives it towards mid off for a single.
Fuller, outside off. Nangeyalia Kharote swings across the line but gets an inside edge onto the pads.

A bit too high! Good-length ball, on middle and leg, coming back in. Nangeyalia Kharote is beaten by the swing and gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls to backward point and Bilal Sayeedi starts running but Nangeyalia Kharote sends him back. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
On middle and leg, Nangeyalia Kharote flicks it behind square on the leg side for a single.
WIDE! Fuller, way too outside off. Nangeyalia Kharote looks to drive but misses. Wided.
Length ball, outside off. Bilal Sayeedi slashes it through point. The fielder in the deep does well to flick the ball in and keep it down to two.

Not a bad shout from Yasiru Rodrigo but the umpire is not interested. Good-length ball, on leg, nipping in. Bilal Sayeedi looks to flick but misses. He gets hit on the pads. Yasiru Rodrigo appeals for an lbw but not given.
Short of a length, outside off. Bilal Sayeedi watches the ball closely and lets it go.
A full toss, outside off. Nangeyalia Kharote drives it towards covers for a single.
TWO WIDES! Slower delivery, down the leg side. Bilal Sayeedi leaves it alone. The keeper fumbles to collect the ball cleanly and the batters steal a single.
On a good length, on middle. Bilal Sayeedi meets it with a dead bat.
Short ball again, on middle. This time Nangeyalia Kharote ducks under it.
FOUR! Short ball and punished! Short ball, on middle. Nangeyalia Kharote gets inside the line and pulls it to deep square leg for a boundary.
Length ball, outside off. Left alone.
Very full, outside off. Nangeyalia Kharote pushes it towards covers.

Due to some power cut on the ground, the coverage was off and hence the ball-to-ball commentary was not availabe from 1.2 to 2.2 overs. Sorry for the inconvenience, but the coverage is back so do not get your eyes off.
Length ball, on middle, shaping back in. Nangeyalia Kharote clears his front leg and nudges it to mid-wicket.
Fuller, on off, coming back in. Nangeyalia Kharote drives it straight to mid off.
WIDE! Length ball, way too outside off. Vinuja Ranpul loses his radar a bit. Nangeyalia Kharote leaves it alone and the umpire calls it a wide.
Superb delivery to end the over! Good-length ball, outside off, angling away. Bilal Sayeedi pushes at it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Short ball, on leg. Bilal Sayeedi ducks under it.
Fuller in length, on leg. Bilal Sayeedi defends it towards covers.
A yorker, on middle. Bilal Sayeedi jams it out towards covers.
The cover drive is played for a run.
That is just a mere push for a run.
Wide! That is left alone for the keeper to collect.
That is defended solidly off the front foot.
The batsman is not interested in playing at that.
No run, the batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
No run, the batsman has just watchfully blocked this out.
No run, that is left alone for the keeper to collect.
Well bowled! Length ball, outside off. Nangeyalia Kharote shoulders arms to that one.
Vinuja Ranpul to bowl from the other end.

Good comeback by the bowler! This falls just short of the first slip fielder. Good-length ball, around off, nipping away. Bilal Sayeedi has a poke at it. The ball takes the outside edge and lands just short of first slip. Encouraging start for Afghanistan Under-19. 8 runs from the first over.
Length ball, outside off. Bilal Sayeedi defends it out.
On a length, outside off, angling away. Bilal Sayeedi leaves it alone.
Good-length ball, on middle. Nangeyalia Kharote plays it to third man for a single.

FOUR! Nangeyalia Kharote is off the mark as well and in some fashion. Beautiful shot! Fuller again, outside off. Nangeyalia Kharote leans onto it and creams it through covers. The ball races away to the fence. Good positive start from the Afghans.
Good running and Bilal Sayeedi is off the mark straightaway! Yasiru Rodrigo starts with a fuller delivery, on the pads. Bilal Sayeedi flicks it to deep square leg for three runs.

We are set for the clash. Sri Lanka Under-19 players are seen to be in a huddle near the ropes before they break out to their fielding positions. Followed by Bilal Sayeedi and Nangeyalia Kharote who walk out to open for Afghanistan Under-19. Yasiru Rodrigo will start with the new ball. Here we go...
Both teams line up for the national anthem. The national anthem of Afghanistan will be played first followed by Sri Lanka's.

PITCH REPORT - Niall O'Brien says that there is a bit of moisture on the pitch. Tells that there are a few cracks as well. Mentions that there is a lot of grass and it is a lively pitch. Adds that the spinners will get some grip and the seamers will enjoy bowling as well. Says that as the day progresses it will be a beautiful batting wicket.

Suliman Safi, the Afghanistan Under-19 skipper, is in for a chat. He says, the wicket is good, it is flat and batting first is not an issue. Mentions they have a single change. Ends by saying they will hope to score a good total here.

Dunith Wellalage, the Sri Lanka Under-19 skipper, says that they will bowl first. Mentions that it is a good wicket but they have a good bowling lineup and they will look to restrict Afghanistan to a lower total. Informs that they have one change. Vinuja Ranpul comes in for Matheesha Pathirana.

Afghanistan Under-19 (Playing XI) - Bilal Sayeedi, Nangeyalia Kharote, Allah Noor, Suliman Safi (C), Ijaz Ahmadzai, Mohammad Ishaq (WK), Noor Ahmad, Abdul Hadi, Izharulhaq Naveed, Bilal Sami, Naveed Zadran (In for Shahidullah Hasani).

Sri Lanka Under-19 (Playing XI) - Chamindu Wickramasinghe, Sadisha Rajapaksa, Shevon Daniel, Sakuna Liyanage, Anjala Bandara (WK), Dunith Wellalage (C), Ranuda Somarathne, Raveen de Silva, Yasiru Rodrigo, Traveen Mathews, Vinuja Ranpul (In for Matheesha Pathirana).
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Sri Lanka Under-19. They have elected to BOWL first.

The Afghans have shown decent form in the tournament. They finished second in the group stage. They lost their second match to Pakistan U-19 but showed great character to comeback from the loss and won their last match against Zimbabwe U-19 with good all round performance. They would want to show the same spirit and character in this match as well. Their batters have blown hot and cold and the onus will be once again on their bowlers to deliver. Both teams look evenly matched on paper. Let's see who comes out on top. Toss and team news in a bit.

Sri Lanka U-19 have had an excellent campaign so far. They won three out of three matches in the group stage. Their bowlers are in exceptional form with their skipper, Dunith Wellalage leading from the front as he has scalped 13 wickets so far from 3 matches. They also have Matheesha Pathirana who has a slingy action like Lasith Malinga. Their batting unit is due for a big performance and they would want them to contribute and win this match and progress further.

Hello everyone! A warm welcome to the coverage of the Under-19 World Cup. This match sees an all Asian clash as Sri Lanka will lock horns against Afghanistan. We are into the business end of the tournament now and the equation here is pretty simple. Whoever wins this match will progress further, while the other would head back home.
